templates.title: Templates
templates.empty: No versions yet. Import a template file to start.

importErrors.tooLarge: This file is too large. Use one under 1 MB.
importErrors.unreadable: This file can't be read. Choose a moonx template file (JSON).
importErrors.otherKind: This is a {{kind}} template file. Import it into {{kind}} instead.
importErrors.format: This file doesn't follow the template file format
importErrors.atTop: At the top of the file

version.title: Edit Template
version.heading: {{kind}} v{{version}}
version.draftLine: Draft. Check it, then publish it.
version.readOnly: A published version can't be changed. Start a new draft from it on Templates.
version.choose: Choose a section, question or setting to see it

question.title: Title
question.keyPublished: This question ID is in a published version, so it can't change.

keyForm.self_analysis: SA, the section key and a number, like SA.WHY.1
keyForm.validation: V, the section (01, 02, 04, 08 or 10) and a key in capitals, digits and _, like V.01.WHO
keyForm.business_plan: P, the item number (01 to 30) and a number, like P.01.1

question.askFau: Ask for F/A/U (Fact, Assumption or Unknown)
question.copyFromForm: Validation question IDs like V.01.WHO, or IDEA.ONE_LINE_CONCEPT, IDEA.PROPOSED_SOLUTION, LIST.ASSUMPTIONS or LIST.RISKS. Several are joined in this order.
question.metricForm: Keys of the key numbers, like break_even_units_day, or cost_row: and a starting cost row's key, like cost_row:initial.permits
question.conditionText: When the answer is (one per line)

check.ready: No problems. Ready to publish as v{{version}}.
check.blocked_one: Fix 1 problem on Check to publish
check.blocked_other: Fix {{count}} problems on Check to publish
check.noneInNodes: No problems in the sections and questions

code.invalid_part_plan: Each item needs Part A or Part B
code.invalid_part_other: Only the items of a plan have a part
code.invalid_question_key: The question ID doesn't follow the question ID format
code.question_key_section_mismatch: The question ID doesn't match its section
code.duplicate_question_key: The question ID is used more than once
code.answer_type_mismatch: This template's answers can't hold this answer type
code.options_mismatch: The choices, columns or key numbers don't fit the answer type
code.unknown_condition_key: Shown when names a question that isn't in the template
code.copy_from_mismatch: This prompt can't hold what it copies from the validation
code.pitch_deck_overflow: A Pitch Deck slide runs past its bottom with the most material

version.publishBody: Answers already written don't change. People on an earlier version can move to v{{version}} when they choose.
version.publishInvalid: This version has problems. Fix them on Check, then publish.
version.publishedUnknown: Couldn't load when it was published.
version.nameNote: It's the template's name, shared by all its versions. Only operators see it.
